sources.title: Visiting Lake Louise and Moraine Lake - Banff National Park

v.note: Reached only on foot by the Larch Valley trail from Moraine Lake; Moraine Lake Road is closed to personal vehicles year-round, so the start is reached by the Parks Canada shuttle or a licensed operator.

access_season.quote: Moraine Lake Road is closed to personal vehicles year-round.
access_season.note: The same access rule as Moraine Lake (the trail starts at its shore); copied to the pass so Plan B sees it (backlog 3.45).
